title: Coconut Rice Pudding
subtitle: Creamy coconut and kaffir lime rice pudding
excerpt: Sushi rice cooked slowly in coconut milk and whole milk until thick and silky, fragrant with kaffir lime and cardamom. Scatter pomegranate seeds over the top to serve.
sourceNotes: Combines the British baked rice pudding tradition with Southeast Asian coconut and kaffir lime flavours.

recipe.makeAheadNotes: Can be made up to 2 hours ahead and kept warm. Add a splash of milk when reheating to loosen.

content.text: Stir the rice frequently once the liquid is simmering. Sushi rice releases a lot of starch and will stick to the bottom of the pan if left unattended.

items.prepNote: rinsed until the water runs clear

content.text: Put the rinsed rice, coconut milk, and whole milk in a large saucepan.
Add the kaffir lime leaves and cardamom. Stir in the honey.
Bring to a gentle simmer over medium heat. Stir well.
Reduce the heat to low. Cook for 25 minutes, stirring every few minutes, until the rice is soft and the pudding has thickened.
Remove the kaffir lime leaves. Stir in the lime zest.
Spoon into bowls and scatter pomegranate seeds over the top. Serve warm.

items.symptom: Rice has stuck to the bottom of the pan.
items.cause: Heat too high or not stirred often enough.
items.fix: Scrape the bottom each time you stir and lower the heat.

items.symptom: Pudding is too liquid after 25 minutes.
items.cause: Rice not rinsed enough or coconut milk very thin.
items.fix: Continue cooking on low heat for a further 10 minutes.

items.symptom: Kaffir lime flavour is very faint.
items.cause: Leaves were not bruised before adding.
items.fix: Crush the leaves in your hands before adding next time.
